# search_text_composition_style()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.search_text_composition_style`

## Signature

```python
async def search_text_composition_style(style: Union[str, 'types.TextCompositionStyle']) -> Optional['types.TextCompositionStyle']: ...
```

## Documentation

Find a text composition style by its name, for example the name in a https://t.me/addstyle/<name> link.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`style`** (`str` | [`TextCompositionStyle`](../../types/messages_and_media/TextCompositionStyle.md))
  Name of the style, or the style itself to get its up to date information.

### Returns

[`TextCompositionStyle`](../../types/messages_and_media/TextCompositionStyle.md) | `None`: On success, the style is returned.

### Example

```python
style = await app.search_text_composition_style("AbCdEf123")
await app.add_text_composition_style(style)
```
